# A failing recipe makes mk exit non-zero and says which target failed and
# how, even when the recipe's own error output is discarded.
! mk -p 1 -f mkfile
stdout 'all: false'
stderr 'recipe for ''all'' failed: exit status 1'

! mk -p 1 -f mkfile quiet
stderr 'recipe for ''quiet'' failed: exit status 3'

-- mkfile --
all:V:
	false

quiet:V:
	sh -c 'echo hidden >&2; exit 3' 2> /dev/null
